_: OpenCaseLaw law-alias table. Names a caller may use for a Swiss federal act or a treaty in the Systematische Rechtssammlung (SR) that are NOT the Fedlex abbreviation the statute mirror stores in abbr_de / abbr_fr / abbr_it (those already resolve — with or without dots and spaces: 'Cst', 'OPP2', 'o.p.p. 2' reach 'Cst.' and 'OPP 2'). Loaded once by mcp_server.get_law, search_laws and GET /api/laws/{abbreviation}. Keys are matched after normalisation: upper-cased, with dots, spaces, hyphens, underscores and slashes removed, so 'Pacte II', 'pacte-ii' and 'PACTEII' are one key.

_kinds.treaty: international treaty in the SR; Fedlex publishes no titleShort for most of them
_kinds.former: a repealed or renamed act whose successor carries the same SR number; get_law serves the current text and says so, pass as_of (see as_of_hint) for the former edition
_kinds.current: an informal name for the act currently in force ('nDSG')
_kinds.act: an act the mirror carries without a usable abbreviation
_kinds.name: another-language or long-form name of an act the mirror abbreviates differently

_verification: Every sr_number was checked on 2026-09-09 against Fedlex SPARQL (jolux:historicalLegalId or the taxonomy notation of a jolux:ConsolidationAbstract; 'verified': 'fedlex-sparql-2026-09-09') or against docs/data/law_codes.json, which is derived from the production statutes.db ('verified': 'docs/data/law_codes.json ...'). Nothing here comes from memory; add entries only with the same check. Aliases whose SR could not be verified are listed under _excluded_unverified and are NOT loaded.

_excluded_unverified.OJF: seen 5x in /api/laws; presumed a French form of OG but not a known Fedlex title — not mapped
_excluded_unverified.LMSD: seen 3x with language=fr; act not identified — not mapped
_excluded_unverified.LAMI: seen 5x; possibly a typo for LAMal or LAMA — not mapped
_excluded_unverified.ALPC: seen 9x; typo for ALCP — typos are not aliases
_excluded_unverified.TJPG: seen 2x; act not identified — not mapped
_excluded_unverified.LTPM: seen 1x with language=fr; act not identified — not mapped

_edition_prefixes.a: aStGB, aZGB, aOR, aBV, aAuG … — the former edition of the act that follows; resolved to the act's SR number with a note; pass as_of for the historical text
_edition_prefixes.n: nStPO, nDSG — the current edition of the act that follows

_cantonal_collections: Systematic-collection labels callers pass in place of a canton code: get_law(abbreviation='LS', article='211.1') is read as canton='ZH', sr_number='211.1'. Only labels that name exactly one canton are listed (GS, BGS, SGS and RB repeat across cantons).
